sentence: In AI-embedded CRM, leadership support lifts both relationship satisfaction and firm performance [CITE], and the companion study reports the same moderating role under AI-CRM
passage: [Chatterjee et al. (2021), p. 213] "our study has shown that for exhibiting better performance, leadership support has a major moderating effect on the firm performance in the B2B context using an AI-CRM system"

gemini.note: The cited passage supports the moderating effect on firm performance but makes no mention of relationship satisfaction.
